actions.new_text: In Joh 11:31, Joh 20:15 and Act 27:13 'supposing' is assuming something to be so: the Jews assume Mary is going to the tomb, Mary assumes Jesus is the gardener, and the sailors assume they have their purpose. In the three verses the assumption is held without testing; in Joh 20:15 the verse itself shows it wrong, and in the other two what follows shows the case.
actions.checked: Joh 11:31 and Act 27:13 (neither verse itself shows the assumption tested)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it said each verse shows the case; only Joh 20:15 does, and the other two are shown by what follows

actions.new_text: The codes of a view held or put to another are G1380 (to think, imagine, suppose, presume), G3543 (to deem, with 1Ti 6:5 named), G3633 (to think, suppose, imagine, presume, with Joh 21:25 and Jam 1:7 named), G5274 (to take up a notion, suppose), G5282 (to suspect, suppose, deem, with Act 13:25 named) and H0559 (to say, to say in one's heart, to think) in 2Sa 13:32 and 2Sa 13:33. The lexicon bears out a view or opinion. G1161 (but, and, then) is a conjunction in the units of 1Cor 8:2 and Rom 2:3 and carries no thinking.
actions.checked: the codes of Jam 4:5 (G1380) and Rom 2:3 (G1161)
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it put G1161 in Jam 4:5; there the code is G1380, and G1161 stands in Rom 2:3
